plantStatus.docs: Current moisture level of a plant

waterPlant.docs: Request that the server water the specified plant.

garden.yml.rawContents:
channel:
  path: /v1/ws/garden
  auth: false
  messages:
    plantStatus:
      origin: server
      body: PlantStatus
      docs: Current moisture level of a plant
    waterPlant:
      origin: client
      body: WaterPlant
      docs: Request that the server water the specified plant.
  examples:
    - messages:
        - type: waterPlant
          body:
            plantId: plantId
        - type: plantStatus
          body:
            moisture: 1.1
types:
  PlantStatus:
    properties:
      moisture: double
    source:
      openapi: ../asyncapi.yml
  WaterPlant:
    properties:
      plantId: string
    source:
      openapi: ../asyncapi.yml

rootApiFile.rawContents:
name: api
error-discrimination:
  strategy: status-code
environments:
  production: wss://api.example.com
default-environment: production
default-url: Base
